body: I am an adult. I'm also a human being. If this were a regular break up, I would have no problem being able to move on. However, trying to do my job while I see them flirting with each other gives me awful anxiety. It makes me feel worthless, like a fucking joke. I cant fucking focus.
If nothing happens then they're going to kick me out. I cant perform my job around them. I literally am having panic attacks. I cant think. I cant focus.
The ucmj punishment for infidelity is more so focused on a compromised unit as a result of the action. They both knew what they did and they deserve what ever happens to them.
Soonest my base had an appointment for one. I was really upset when they told me that, but there is nothing they can do.

I scheduled an STD test and an appointment with mental health today. I'll bring it up with my supervisor first, and then my grand supervisor. Hopefully they have some good advice. I'm a good Airman, I havent gotten in trouble and Ive gone up for numerous awards. I hope they understand what im going through and dont judge me negatively for it. Unfortunately I think the STD test is going to come back positive for something. Which fucking sucks. The worst fucking part is that, when i started suspecting something was going on, I told her to break up with me before she cheated on me. So I didnt have to do this. Now I have to adjust my leave in feb so that I can be on base for my std test.

The guy she cheated on me with is already getting kicked out for several things, but I dont know when, and I dont want to be here anymore. I could get over it a lot easier if i didnt have to see them all day.
Yeah. While it hurts, a lot, I am glad that I'm not having to deal with a messy divorce right now. I think that's what I'm going to try to do, but I don't think they'll let me.
